how_to_apply: Download the official notification and annexed Application Proforma (Annexure-I) and Declaration Form (Annexure-II).
Carefully and accurately fill in the Application Proforma and Declaration Form.

Prepare scanned, self-attested copies of original supporting documents, certificates from matriculation onwards, date-of-birth proof, degree/provisional degree certificates, NET/GATE certificates, experience certificates, publications, and a recent passport-size photograph.
Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email after application screening.

Attend the walk-in interview on 05.11.2026 at 10:30 A.M. at the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi 110012, carrying the duly filled application proforma, declaration form, and original copies of all relevant documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for one year or till completion/termination of the concerned project, whichever is earlier. All posts are co-terminus with the respective project, and selected candidates shall have no claim for regular appointment or absorption in ICAR/IARI. Applications will be screened, and only eligible and shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the date and time of the offline interview. No TA/DA or any other expenses will be paid for attending the interview. Concealment of facts or submission of false information will lead to disqualification or termination of candidature. Candidates having near or distant relatives employed in ICAR/IARI must declare the details in Annexure-II. Selected candidates must abide by institute rules including laboratory safety, biosafety, and data security norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the ICAR IARI recruitment 2026 about?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment for 3 temporary and contractual positions of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Young Professional-I (YP-I) under PPV&FRA and ICAR funded projects at the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies: 1 post for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 2 posts for Young Professional-I (YP-I).

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 5 November 2026 at 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi 110012.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Vegetable Science/ Horticulture/ Genetics and Plant Breeding/ Plant Biotechnology with a 4-year/5-year Bachelor's degree, or a Master's degree with a 3-year Bachelor's degree along with NET qualification and 2 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates with at least 60% marks in relevant Agriculture Sciences/ Engineering/ Technology as per ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for SRF and Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years for both posts. The maximum age is 35 years for SRF and 45 years for Young Professionals, with admissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What are the emoluments for SRF and Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: SRF receives Rs. 37,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 + HRA from the third year onwards. Young Professional-I receives a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the respective project, with no claim for regular appointment or absorption in ICAR/IARI.
